correction.finding: identity_keys.transaction_unique_key in immutable #249 interface includes brand_id/app_id/environment while billing_verified_receipt.unique[0] and ADR list only provider/store_namespace/store_transaction_ref.
correction.resolution: Use the compact provider + canonical store_namespace + officially verified store_transaction_ref as the SINGLE proposed durable receipt uniqueness constraint. Retain brand_id/app_id/environment as separately checked, immutable scope columns and as an expanded logical lookup/provenance projection, NOT an alternative unique index.

verified_meanings.brand_id: The trusted registry's Starry brand; not from a client-supplied brand flag.
verified_meanings.app_id: The canonical central App Registry app identity that is bound to the verified Store application identity, not a free-form request app switch.
verified_meanings.environment: The trusted Starry app execution environment, checked separately from the Store's Sandbox/Production verification environment.
verified_meanings.provider_store_application_identity: An authenticated Store application identity such as its verified application/package binding, with actual identifier undecided; NO hard-coded bundle/package.
verified_meanings.store_verification_environment: Provider-verified Sandbox vs Production provenance; a test purchase cannot be reinterpreted as production.
verified_meanings.provider_authority_or_account_namespace: The independently verified Store issuer/tenant/account trust namespace IF needed to guarantee collision isolation; actual provider accounts and credentials are NOT selected. Without a uniquely binding official issuer namespace, refuse authority.

canonical_store_namespace.provider_field_rule: Receipt provider is the independently verified authoritative Store (Apple or Google, as future approved), NOT RevenueCat client status. RC-only webhook/CustomerInfo may be supplemental but never independently creates an authoritative Store receipt.
canonical_store_namespace.derive_policy: Only a protected server-side approved immutable App Registry mapping and independently official verified Store evidence can derive the tuple. User inputs, app-selected product keys, untrusted RC identity, R007/R008 review_only labels, environment headers, query params and offline HMAC are NEVER namespace authority.
canonical_store_namespace.immutability: A verified original transaction's namespace tuple is immutable after first claim. Change of app/brand/environment/Store app/provider trust domain never rewrites or relocates ownership; cross-scope reuse DENY unless separately owner-approved lineage transfer procedure exists (not approved).
canonical_store_namespace.canonical_encoding: If later implemented, a reviewed collision-free, domain-separated, versioned canonical tuple encoding with explicit component boundaries and registry consistency check is required. Concatenation without length boundaries, user-supplied opaque strings, case-folding guesses or hashing without approved collision/migration policy are forbidden.
required_scope_checks: The trusted request brand_id/app_id/environment equals canonical namespace binding and the persisted receipt's immutable brand_id/app_id/environment.

The official Store verification environment and application identity match the approved registry entry and the namespace; no staging/development claim reclassifies a production purchase or vice versa.
Receipt lookups and first-claim attempts reject cross-brand, cross-app, cross-environment or foreign provider-store application tuples BEFORE insert and again at authoritative CAS boundary.
A second s_user_id using the same original transaction within its independently verified namespace is a CONFLICT; membership never participates in lineage unique key.

Two different canonical namespaces may contain equal-looking opaque provider transaction strings only with separately official evidence that they are different Store authority/application/verification domains; unsupported namespace mapping is always DENY.

first_claim_lineage.semantics: One originally verified purchase lineage can be claimed once by one member for its canonical issuer/Store namespace; no member-scoped alias can grant another first claim. Identity/scope must be preverified and persisted immutable.

receipt.semantics: Store transaction/receipt has one authoritative key; multiple lifecycle changes can refer to it. Persist scope guard fields but do not expand physical unique to alternative client-controlled scope.

provider_lifecycle_event.semantics: Distinct officially accepted purchase, renewal, refund, revoke, grace, expire events can reference one receipt/transaction; duplicate event ref is replay/idempotent no-op; don't use transaction ID as event uniqueness.
provider_lifecycle_event.relation_to_receipt: Event references verified receipt by canonical receipt key and original lineage; no unverified event can update receipt/entitlement.
provider_lifecycle_event.rc_semantics: RevenueCat event IDs and source versions occupy a separate supplemental provider/source namespace. They cannot be compared to Apple/Google versions to prove precedence or create a second receipt authority.

entitlement.semantics: Entitlement scoped per approved member/app/env via current Auth and verified provider rights; not a substitute for original purchase lineage uniqueness.

static_review_cases.case: one canonical namespace, same verified transaction ref, same member retry
one canonical namespace, same original purchase, different member
request claims new app or env for existing verified original transaction
same Store receipt, two distinct officially verified lifecycle event refs (purchase then refund)
same canonical namespace and provider event ref redelivered
RevenueCat event with same apparent Store transaction
same-looking opaque transaction ref under different verified issuer/store app domains
Store Sandbox proof replayed as Production or stage header changes scope

remaining_review_dependencies: AI-0 and AI-4 must approve exact protected App Registry to Store application identity mapping and domain separation before any writer implementation.
Official Apple/Google evidence verifier, issuer/account namespace and Store test authority require separate owner approval.
AI-1 current Auth Session fence, AI-3 outbox/inbox/anti-PITR and D06 final schema remain independent unresolved requirements.
Physical D1 identity, migration constraints, storage transaction semantics, rollback, SKU policies, Q104/Q119 retention and budget remain unapproved.
